The club competes in the [[Kategoria Superiore]], the top tier of [[Football in Albania|Albanian football]]. Their home ground is the [[Niko Dovana Stadium]]. The club was founded on 29 January 1920 as ''Klubi Sportiv Urani'' (Uranium Sport Club), and they were a founding member of the [[Albanian Superliga|Albanian National Championship]] in 1930, as well as runners-up in the [[1931 Albanian Superliga|1931 National Championship]]. They have won the [[Kategoria Superiore]] twice in 1994 and in 2021, and they have also won the [[Albanian Cup]] four times, as well as finishing runners-up in three [[Albanian Supercup]]s."}}
